about: Decision caps and time limits for the task-family runners (tools/batch.py, tools/batch_settings.py in families-v6-tools.zip). A variant not listed gets the defaults. The time limit is per variant and setting, for all seeds and episodes together. 25 Nov 2026 (evening, JL): the five arithmetic variants that solved 1,000 to 10,000 problems now solve 100 (original and World); they need at most about 4,300 decisions (seeds 1-3, every learning setting, library v2.47, both versions), so they get 10,000. Knights-6 and knights-8 stop after 100 closed tours or 30,000 moves and then report their result; they need up to about 4,600 and 30,100 decisions (seeds 1-3, library v2.47, both versions), so they get 40,000. mac-look-ahead gets 80,000: with learning off (not its own setting) the World version's iterative deepening repeats every shallower search and needs about 52,000-56,000 decisions (seeds 1-3, v2.47).
